name: Catan
description: Trade and build settlements on an island of hexagonal tiles. Collect resources and expand your territory.

name: Ticket to Ride
description: Collect train cards to claim railway routes across a map. Connect cities and complete destination tickets.

name: Codenames
description: Give one-word clues to help your team identify secret agents while avoiding the assassin.

name: Pandemic
description: Work together as disease-fighting specialists to cure four deadly infections threatening the world.

name: Azul
description: Draft colorful tiles to decorate a palace wall. Score points for patterns and complete sets.

name: Wingspan
description: Attract birds to your wildlife preserves. Each bird has unique powers and scoring opportunities.

name: Splendor
description: Collect gems to purchase development cards and attract nobles. Build an economic engine to win.

name: 7 Wonders
description: Lead one of the seven greatest cities of the ancient world. Draft cards to develop your civilization.

name: Carcassonne
description: Place tiles to build a medieval landscape of cities roads and fields. Deploy followers to score points.

name: Terraforming Mars
description: Compete as corporations to make Mars habitable. Raise temperature oxygen and ocean levels.

name: Gloomhaven
description: Cooperative dungeon-crawling adventure with branching storylines and tactical combat.

name: Scythe
description: Alternate reality 1920s Europe. Build farms factories and mechs to dominate the land.

name: Dixit
description: Use imaginative storytelling with surreal illustrated cards. Guess which card matches the clue.

name: King of Tokyo
description: Play as giant monsters battling for control of Tokyo. Roll dice to attack heal or gain energy.

name: Root
description: Asymmetric woodland game where each faction plays by different rules. Fight for control of the forest.

name: Spirit Island
description: Defend your island home from colonizing invaders using elemental spirits with unique powers.

name: Love Letter
description: Quick deduction card game of risk and bluffing in a royal court. Deliver your letter to the princess.

name: Hanabi
description: Cooperative card game where you hold cards facing away and give clues about colors and numbers.

name: Dominion
description: Deck-building game where you start with a small deck and buy cards to build a powerful engine.

name: Betrayal at House on the Hill
description: Explore a haunted mansion tile by tile until one player becomes a traitor.

name: The Crew
description: Cooperative trick-taking card game where players must complete missions without talking.

name: Everdell
description: Build a city of critters and constructions in a whimsical woodland valley over four seasons.

name: Brass Birmingham
description: Build networks of canals and rails during the industrial revolution in Birmingham.

name: Wingspan Asia
description: Expansion-style standalone with new birds and powers for the Wingspan engine.

name: Qwirkle
description: Match colors and shapes in a grid without repeating attributes in any line. Simple rules deep strategy.

name: Clank
description: Deck-building dungeon crawl where you sneak into a dragon's lair to steal an artifact.
